study: Coat current-interface case, prespecified metadata queries
status_at_registration: planned before inspecting new case outcomes
unit: 290 user blocks, at most one uniformly chosen observed item per user per source
target: Study-user-generating distribution under iid user blocks, not a general consumer population
actions: All 300 published items, including empty thinned cells
q: Uniform 1/300, from published random-16 assignment followed by independent uniform thinning
group_weights: uniform over the concrete items in each metadata category; overlapping partitions
methods: fusion group score half alpha per source
fusion projected cells half alpha per source
stronger_transport_controls: direct R score, one event per user, one-sided Hoeffding
direct R score, all 16 ratings averaged within user, one-sided Hoeffding; n remains 290
R full-cell simultaneous CP, static full-cell transport
interpretation: Group-source comparisons require declared sensitivity, selected-group transport and iid study-user blocks. Direct R/full-cell controls additionally use static full-cell rating transport; do not claim a group-only advantage against a handicap. A single real dataset cannot validate coverage or transport.
uncertainty: Each fixed query's direct score has a 95% one-sided Hoeffding bound under independent users/assignments and static ratings; no multiple-query selection based on these individual score bounds. Confidence-view bounds already share the fixed-view simultaneous event.
stopping_rule: One thinning seed, all 15 prespecified metadata queries, all 12 sensitivity declarations, no seed or feature selection based on results. Retain no-certificate and refusal results.
license: CC BY-NC 4.0 per author project page; preserve attribution and transformations; no author code reused.
